nom: RoC Retinol Line Smoothing Anti Wrinkle for Dark Circles Eye Cream

avis.texte: I bought this hoping that it would get rid of some wrinkles under my eyes. It said you should see instant results but didn't see anything for a week. Its okay, but not as advertised which is wrong in my book.
I have been using ROC eye cream for over 15 years almost every day. If you are in yours 20's, start now. I have almost no wrinkles around eyes and I am 51 y/o!
I went through the entire tube, it dindt make any difference. I bought two on sale months ago, a mini and full suze. I'll finish the last tube but will not be buying again.

The actual product is great! I love that this is a gentle retinol that I can use on my eyes AND my neck!My skin can be sensitive and reactive, but this causes no redness or itching. You only need the tiniest amount so the tube lasts a long time. The thing I HATE is the packaging. I've been using this for years, and every time I get a new tube, the product spills out for the first 5 or 10 ten uses. A lot of product gets wasted. Also, after many uses, the tube always breaks open near the seam somewhere, causing even more product to be wasted. I usually put a couple bandaids around the tear so I can continue using it, as it always happens when the tube is still half full. I continue to purchase because I really do like it, especially for the price! But I won't hesitate to drop it if something better comes along. TLDR: The actual product is FANTASTIC. The packaging is the literal WORST. Worth it for now.

avis.titre: Actually lightens skin around the eyes!!
avis.texte: Totally recommend this product for anyone who really struggles with dark skin around the eyes. I can't say it has tightened my eyes much, but the color change is drastic! Will buy again.

I love the ROC vitamin C eye stick (hate the packaging but love the product!) so I wanted to try something for my nightly routine that would help with my fine lines under my eyes. (I'm almost 30!) I have used this every night for just a few weeks, and my fine lines are halfway gone! You can hardly notice them now! Will be purchasing again!

I purchased this for my undereye fine lines. The tube you get is so tiny. Maybe I didnt use long enough, but after an entire tube, I did not notice a difference in my under eye fine lines. I have not repurchased.

avis.titre: I I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I've only been using this product for two weeks and I'm already noticing improvements in my skin pigmentation.

avis.titre: Favorite eye cream ever - and it ACTUALLY WORKS!!
avis.texte: Okay, so, I have recently gained this new deep line (or two... or twenty) that I had almost given up hope in even just softening. Well! I've been using the Line Smoothing Eye Cream for a couple of months now, and THAT LINE IS AT LEAST HALFWAY GONE!! I'm just a regular person, who decided to give Roc a try after so many other brands that did NOT work, and now I'm so happy I could cry. If you purchase ONE thing from Roc, let it be this eye cream!

Lightly hydrating, affordable, and perfect everyday eye cream I always come back to. I've tried others and haven't liked most other options as much as this one. It's by no means the greatest out there, but it's just an all around solid choice.
The eyes retinol gives my skin the moisture it needs to prevent wrinkles on the sides of my eyes.

I've been using this eye cream for 2+ years. I am a 41yr old female. No smoking, alcohol on rare occasion. This was recommended by a "Best of" list a few years ago and it was praised for its moisturizing effects and smoothing out and preventing wrinkles around the eyes. This is moisturizing, smoothing and I barely see any wrinkles around my eyes. Even my 50yr old sister asked me what I used. I highly recommend this product. The longer you use it, the greater the results.
This product is awful. My eyes are swollen and red and dry from Using it !!!! My wrinkles look worse not any better, I never have reactions from products and this one is garbage!!! do NOT buy!
This is my favorite eye cream and a little goes a long ways. It is a bit on the pricier side, but it works so well and lasts a long time.

avis.titre: Don't see any difference after nearly a year
avis.texte: No improvement of fine lines, wrinkles or crows feet in the eye area after nearly a year of using it.
Worth the price. This little tube gets rid of my puffiness and dark circles. I mainly use this product every morning.
Excellent! I use this everyday and its working. The lines under my eyes soft out anf almost gone. Awesome@
I only started on this and I like it. Haven't noticed a difference yet but I just got it.

avis.titre: dont know if i would buy it again its kinda expensive.
avis.texte: dont see any results yet under my eyes yet, its been a few days that ive been outting it on.
I have tried other products and nothing compares to this.If you have sensitive eyes this is great as well.A little goes a long way.
Recently bought this and it will definitely be my eye cream going forward. Reasonably priced and does what I'm looking for
I am 69 years old and have been using this product twice a day for 6 weeks no change. Disappointed
It seems to be working after two weeks. My eyes seem to be less puffy but still dark. Need to keep using.
Love the product! Non sticky and smoothing. Can't wait to restock.
I was gifted this last month and have loved the results it leaves in my skin. I struggle with some pigmentation and dark under eyes and have seen the change in my skin.

Loved this! this is the first retinol eye cream i've used and although i can't speak yet on long term results, it's kept my (super dry) undereyes hydrated all day and i feel like it's helping keeping the fine lines smoother, so i'll keep being constant with it but for now, 10/10
I love how non irritating this is. My undress are so sensitive and usually any kind of anti-aging products cause some kind of pain or reaction but this was so soothing and didn't cause any issues!!!
amazing An incredible product, 100% recommended, I love it!!!!
I'm happy with the results, it's going well I have to keep doing this everyday
I love this eye cream, I've noticed such a difference in my eyes looking bright and vibrant since using this product!
I bought this pretty recently because I wanted to test out the Brand but so far so good. Feels like really high-quality.
This product really works! It reduces the fine lines around my eyes and the puffiness underneath my eyes!

I really like this eye cream! I remember my mom using it and now I know why. I usually have sensitive skin around my eyes so I have to be careful. It doesn't irritate my eyes at all and seems to be effective.

I have been using RoC eye creams twice a day for over 10 years and tried the RoC retinol correction line smoothing eye cream just last year. I absolutely love it and have been using it daily ever since then. Not only has it turned the clock back on my fine lines, but it has also improved my skin so much that my makeup doesn't look cakey under my eyes any more. I saw results in just a couple of months. It is easy to apply and absorbs quickly. The smooth texture leaves my eye area feeling smooth and nourished. This is the best retinol eye cream I've found on the market. The quality compares to high end creams, without the high price. I can honestly say adding this product to my skincare routine has given me the confidence to go makeup free more often because now I don't have fine lines to hide. I credit this eye cream for giving me an eye age 15 years younger than my real age when I used the AI skin analysis.
This is a holy grail for preventing and curing your fine lines! Love it!
Super hydrating and moisturizing. Great retinol, slowly fading the appearance of fine lines. Sinks into the skin easily, doesn't feel oily or greasy.
I've been using this for a few weeks and love the results! My skin looks smoother, fine lines are fading, and it doesn't irritate. Lightweight and perfect for nightly use. Definitely a keeper!

I've been using the Retinol Correxion Line Smoothing Eye Cream for a few weeks now, and I'm honestly impressed. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue, which is perfect for my sensitive under-eye area. Over time, I've noticed my fine lines looking softer and my skin feels smoother and more hydrated. It's gentle enough to use daily, and I appreciate that it doesn't irritate my eyes at all. Definitely a great addition to my skincare routine if you're looking to tackle early signs of aging around the eyes!
Got this 6 week ago and I see visible reduction in wrinkles around my eyes. It works like magic! The texture is smooth and light so it's absorbed pretty quickly too.
So plumping, worked wonderful at minimizing the appearance of fine lines. So hydrating and moisturizing too.
Love this eye cream it's been working so well on my lines since I can't use tret on that area !

I have been using this product religiously and I love it!! People have commented on how bright my under eyes are and how I have no dark circles. This product truly saved me and I even got family members using this because of me! This is a staple in my skincare routine and a must buy!
The only thing that actually made a difference in improving my under eye texture. No irritation whatsoever just good results!
I love the way this product melts into my skin and makes its so smooth.

avis.titre: Perfect after pulling an all nighter
avis.texte: I like how the eye cream reduce my dark circles and doesn't have a strong scent

I've been using the RoC Skincare eye correction cream and it's actually pretty decent. It has a lightweight texture that sinks in fast without feeling greasy. I've noticed some improvement in puffiness and fine lines nothing extreme, but enough to make it worth using consistently. It doesn't irritate my eyes, which is a huge plus for me. Overall, not a miracle in a tube, but definitely a solid product to keep in my routine.
Beyond happy that I bought this!! Do yourself a favor and get this!! RoC never ceases to amaze!
Roc skincare is know about their retinol. Of course it will help

Lightweight and gentle, this eye cream helps reduce fine lines, puffiness, and dark circles. With retinol and a mineral blend, it smooths and brightens over time. Great for sensitive skin, though some may experience mild irritation. Affordable and effective for daily use.

I have bought and used this product several times at least and I do really see a difference in the lines around my eyes when I'm using. There is no magic cure in a tube to permanently get rid of lines but this stuff makes a big difference. I can see the difference when I'm out of this product.

avis.titre: Avoid if you have skin sensitivity
avis.texte: Do NOT use if you have ANY skin sensitivity! This left my under eyes very irritated - red, dry, crusty. It's probably a good product for those without skin sensitivity, but definitely avoid it if you do have sensitivity. Super bummed because this is my problem area.

Product did nothing for my eyes. I was hoping this cream would help my dark under eye circles so that I wouldn't have to use as much concealer. Unfortunately it did absolutely nothing it claims to do. I used the entire tube up and my dark under eye circles and puffiness are just as bad as they were before I started using the product.
The company canceled my order without a reason, so I am disappointed and can not recommend.

Doesnt do anything my regular moisturizer doesnt do. Its really expensive just for something that provides moisture to my under eyes (which my moisturizer already does). Havent noticed any other positive results other than moisturization. Also, it resulted in clusters of milia on both my undereyes. Wont be repurchasing.
Great product, so happy with results after using for a few weeks

I received a sample of this when I bought their vitamin C serum. So I decided to try it one night. I applied it exactly how it said to. Woke up the next morning with my eyes swollen, red, and itchy. Fast forward 2 weeks later and they are still swollen (although not as bad), red and itchy. I look 10 years older now! I do not recommend this product at all!

Another great RoC product my very sensitive skin tolerates without any problems and has done wonders for wrinkles around my eyes and it definitely brightens up my eyes so I guess I had dark circles and didn't know it! Great Retinol Eye Cream!!

I've been looking for a retinol eye cream and this one had great reviews. I've been using retinol on my face and neck for a year now and wanted to add an eye cream. Unfortunately I'm allergic to this and had an immediate reaction to it. I only tried it twice and the reaction was so bad both times I gave up.
I've been using this product for several years and I have no reason to stop.

So far so good with this eye cream. At first my skin was dry and flaky after using the first few days, but now it's all good. I can't say I have noticed any difference in my wrinkles though - at this point in my life I do not have high hopes for that. :)

My upper eye lids were awfully dry and puffy. This helped in smoothing my dry upper eye lids and under eyes. May have helped in making some of my under eye bags and under eye wrinkles. Did not get rid of them. Still on the hunt for a product to alleviate my under eye bags!
I liked this eye cream and would buy it again if they changed the packaging.
This is a great eye cream. My skin is very sensitive and this product is that. My under eyes looks more bright and smooth. It takes only a little but works great.

I didnt see much difference except my vision being blurred. I took a break from the cream thinking maybe it was just me. J tried it again and my vision was so blurred the next day, I could not drive. Not a good cream whatsoever.
I was skeptical about this product. I used as directed and saw a real transformation in my puffy eye. Next product I am going to try is the eyelid cream. I am a believer.

I have been using this eye cream since 2022 and there has been a dramatic decrease in the lines around my eyes. Some lines are gone. My results took close to a year to see with daily use twice a day. I'm 51 and I don't spend time in the sun which helps a lot. I did not experience any skin sensitivity while using. The small travel size tube can last for several months because you only need the size of a pea or smaller to use. It keeps the eye area hydrated which is why you only need a small amount. I highly recommend.

28 y/o female. I bought this 3 weeks ago. I used it no more than 5 times and my lower eyelid has been twitching ever since. So far it's been 9 days straight with the eye twitch persisting every 3-5 minutes. I've never had this happen before and this is my first time trying RoC products. I discontinued the use and I hope the twitching stops eventually.
Doesn't do what it said it would. Ended up irritating my eyes and not delivering anything it promised. Into the trash it goes. Meh.

I used this for 1-2 weeks under my eyes, and then on one day, like suggested, I applied my face cream with spf over it (like I'd been doing all along), but this time it created a burn blister below and just to the outside of my eye. It's healing fine, but will not use it anymore.

I'm a huge fan of the RoC skincare line, but this eye cream does not agree with my skin. Even though it's supposed to be "gentle" on the eyes, it's unfortunately not the case for me. Every time I used this eye cream my eye area would get itchy and irritated. I would keep rubbing my eyes and causing more irritation. Eventually I just threw it away and use the retinol serum capsules.

I used this for two or three days and by the fourth day my eyes were swollen, red and stung so badly. I've used this in the past with no issue, so I don't know if it's a new formula or if my skin has just become more sensitive, but I can't use this eye cream anymore.

My eyes have never looked so smooth and glowy. Fine lines have definitely diminished. I will not be without this product. The entire RoC skincare line is so under rated. Can't wait to try other products.
Hands down best eye cream I've used in such a short amount of time!

I'm 27 & have noticed a few wrinkles/fine lines around my eyes the past couple of years &&&& I've always struggled with dark circles/the inner corner part of my eye being dark. I have tried sooooo many different eye creams & serums. This is the only product I have used & actually noticed a difference. Helps with wrinkles, dramatically improved my dark circles, & is super hydrating as well. Also affordable. Can't beat it!

avis.titre: Love this. Small sample size but lasts forever.
avis.texte: Love this. Does the trick around the eyes. Sample size but lasts forever.

I'm 25, and just started developing a few eye wrinkles. I started using using this eye cream about a month or two ago, and all the eye wrinkles are fully gone! People who are 20 think that I'm younger than them! Bartenders and waiters ask for my ID again and really check that it's legit. I've had 3 people in the last week say they thought I was a highschooler. I am amazed at how quickly this made my eyes look baby-new again.

I bought it for the eyes and for the face, it's a lie. It doesn't work and it doesn't remove the black circles, nor does it reduce the bags and the cream doesn't reduce the lines. I was using the product for more than 1 year. I thought over time I would see a change. It's a fraud this cream

avis.titre: The only eye cream that didn't give me milia
avis.texte: I could not use eye creams because I would always get milia around my eyes. I've tried multiple types of eye creams. Now that I'm in my thirties I'm noticeing more dryness and fine lines around my eyes and I need eye cream and I finally think I found an eye cream that not only helps with dryness and fine lines but also doesnt give me milia. I will be using this till I die now. You only need a little and I also use a little bit for my laugh lines and it helps that too.

avis.titre: first week and notice a difference, i'm 40
avis.texte: i started using this, about 5 days ago. i'm using it every other day. i actually notice a difference already. it's really helping me look much less tired under my eyes. i have some eye bags and it's helping those as well as puffiness. also the directions are clear, don't put it on your eye lid. just under the eye and sides. love it. thanks

I LOVE THIS STUFF!!! I do gave sensitive skin so i have to moisturize really well with eye patched before using this but i have noticed a really sigificant improvement in my eye wrinkles. the dark circles are still dark but that might just be my reality.
Just a thin and watery cream. There are better eye creams offered.

I know most retinol cream reviews have lots of people saying "it works!" But seriously, this stuff works. I'm in my mid thirties and take skincare seriously. I'm luckly to have few wrinkles so far but I do have some laugh lines that I've been trying to get rid of. I know this is really eye cream and I have been using it around the eyes as a preventative measure but I've also been applying it to those laugh lines. After about two weeks, those lines are straight up GONE. I'm like, how is this possible? But it's true. So when my current full face retinol cream runs out I'm buying ROC's version. This stuff is great. A little goes a long way. My only complaint is at first when I used it it did cause some bunpy skin under my eyes but that quickly went away and may have been purging which can be inevitable and not the formula's fault.

I have been thru 12 years of agony w trying to get help for my ex husband & friend I hv discharged a TON of emotional baggage & improving every day . This is now my time to rediscover Cheryl & start putting myself together. I hv tried to buy your product 2 or 3 times in the stores . Every time I did.....THE SHELVES WERE EMPTY. That spoke volumes so I ordered online thank so much for Stellar customer service. I love my products. P.S. the No. 7 still had plenty of product left....😁😁🤟
I love all ROC skincare! I have used it for several years and recommend to all my friends. I get compliments on my skin all the time.
This does not agree with my skin. It may be good for others but not for me.

avis.titre: Made my eyes look more tired
avis.texte: This eye cream did not work for me. It iritated my skin so much that i was waking up with puffy red eyes, looking more tired. It was doing the opposite of what i wanted. It even gave me pimples sroumd the eye area.

I repurchased this eye cream because it performed so well. Retinol creams can be very irritating around the eyes, but not this one. I love that it has retinol and it is gentle enough to use around the eyes. It helps with crow's feet, dark circles and puffy eyes.

Amazing retinol eye cream for both day and night! I have been so pleased with the results in the eye area! I noticed the biggest difference when I stopped using it for a few weeks!!! My eye area just didn't look the same. I am not sure I will every be caught without this eye creme in my skincare regime.

I have been using this forever especially because a little goes a long way. The price is great for thr quality especially on dark circles for me personally. I got my mother one for Christmas to try out! Only con is to make sure you dont bend the tube since the tube can easily get a cut into it that way and have product coming out of it.
It seems to be getting rid of some of the bagginess around my eyes

avis.titre: Nice texture, don't know if it works.
avis.texte: Too soon to tell if I'm going to see any improvements, but I like the cream and it doesn't pill.

I've been using this product for over a year, but recently have developed redness, irritation, swelling, flakiness primarily on left eyelid. I stopped all products, except ROC Eye cream which says to apply AROUND the eyes. After extensive research, I read retinol on eyelids is a NO NO, even ROC's eye retinol. It should only be applied under the eye. Shouldn't ROC state this on their product and website?

avis.titre: no difference in using this product
avis.texte: I bought this based on reviews but after using it as directed have seen absolutely no difference in the bags under my eyes. While it's not terribly expensive I would not recommend spending a penny on it based purely on my experience. Others may have had different results.
More even skin tone, less wrinkles and improved moisture around my eyes.
Super absorbent, really does help the under eye puffiness, and the lines are smoother already and I've been using this for less than a month.
I wouldn't buy this eye cream again. I didn't notice any difference. Not moisturizing. My eyes felt dry and irritated. Little product for the price..

ive been hsing this product every night for about a month and OH MY GOD!!! my milia (little white bumps around eyes) are going away without going to get them cut out. i never really experienced sensitivity to it because i followrd the reccomenfation of every other day for the first few weeks. but if tou have the white bumps i HIGHLY reccomend this!

I haven't been using for long enough to say whether this will get rid of dark circles (which is why I bought it) however.. I liked the way it glides on, it feels so good on my face. Also major ups for not making my eyes water which was the issue with a different cream I purchased.
A MUST HAVE IN EVERY WOMANS HOME!! The Results are Spot on and Visable.
I have been using it for two weeks and noticed that my under eye skin looks good and moist. I don't notice a huge difference in terms of darkness.

I have loved an dused this eye cream for years. The current tube is frustrating. It gets too much pressure built up and leaks all the time. This is a brand new tube I bought yesterday. That's like 5 applications wasted.
It's a very soft cream but covers the skin immediately, and stays soft all day. I used it only for a week, but see the softening of the lines under the eyes already.
I've seen improvement in the lines around my eye…..softer looking.
